name: Exp_CoppockHist
summary: This EA trades based on the Coppock Curve histogram indicator, opening buy positions when the histogram turns upward from below and sell positions when it turns downward from above. It uses a custom CoppockHist indicator with configurable ROC periods, smoothing, and applied price, and delegates trade execution and money management to the TradeAlgorithms library.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Coppock曲线直方图指标进行交易，当直方图从下方上拐时开多仓，从上方下拐时开空仓。它使用可配置的ROC周期、平滑方法和适用价格的CoppockHist自定义指标，并将交易执行和资金管理委托给TradeAlgorithms库。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Coppock曲线指标，该指标通过两个不同周期的变化率（ROC）之和再经移动平均平滑来衡量市场动量。入场条件为：当直方图Value[1]<Value[2]（前期下降）且Value[0]>Value[1]（当前回升）时触发买入信号；当直方图Value[1]>Value[2]（前期上升）且Value[0]<Value[1]（当前回落）时触发卖出信号。出场条件为：买入信号同时触发空头平仓，卖出信号同时触发多头平仓，另外还设置了固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持五种资金管理模式，包括固定手数、基于余额/可用保证金的比例等。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数，根据MMMode模式动态计算下单手数。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Coppock Curve indicator, which measures market momentum by summing two Rate of Change (ROC) values with different periods and then smoothing the result with a moving average. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is triggered when the histogram Value[1]<Value[2] (previously declining) and Value[0]>Value[1] (currently rising), while a sell signal is triggered when Value[1]>Value[2] (previously rising) and Value[0]<Value[1] (currently falling). Exit conditions are: the buy signal simultaneously triggers closing of short positions, and the sell signal triggers closing of long positions, with additional fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels in points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter which sets the risk ratio, supporting five money management modes including fixed lot size and percentage-based sizing on balance or free margin. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library's BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen functions to dynamically calculate order lot sizes based on the selected MMMode.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio, risk per trade

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing mode: free margin/balance/post-loss free margin/post-loss balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow buy position close (close long on reverse signal)

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow sell position close (close short on reverse signal)

pros: Coppock曲线是经典的长期动量指标，逻辑清晰有理论依据
支持多种资金管理模式和灵活的开关控制，可分别开关买卖开平仓
使用IsNewBar机制避免同根K线重复交易，减少过度交易风险
止损止盈参数可配置，提供基本风险保护
pros_en: The Coppock Curve is a classic long-term momentum indicator with clear theoretical foundation
Supports multiple money management modes and flexible enable/disable toggles for buy/sell open/close independently
Uses IsNewBar mechanism to prevent repeated trading on the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters provide basic risk protection
cons: 没有止损止盈为零时的保护检查，若设为0可能导致无限制亏损
没有点差过滤和最大持仓检查，在高点差或极端行情下可能产生意外交易
指标依赖外部自定义指标CoppockHist和SmoothAlgorithms库，部署复杂且缺乏源码审查
信号逻辑仅在直方图方向变化时触发，没有确认机制，可能产生频繁假信号
cons_en: No protection when stop-loss or take-profit is set to zero, which could lead to unlimited losses
No spread filter or maximum position check, potentially causing unexpected trades during high-spread or extreme market conditions
Depends on external custom indicator CoppockHist and SmoothAlgorithms library, making deployment complex and limiting source code review
Signal logic triggers only on histogram direction change without confirmation mechanism, potentially producing frequent false signals
improvements: 增加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，提高交易安全性
增加信号确认机制，如要求直方图穿越零线或结合其他指标过滤假信号
improvements_en: Add spread filter and maximum position count limits to improve trading safety
Add signal confirmation mechanism, such as requiring histogram zero-line crossover or combining with other indicators to filter false signals

risk_points: 止损和止盈参数无零值保护，可能意外设为0导致无限风险敞口
没有点差过滤机制，在流动性差的市场可能以极大滑点成交
risk_points_en: No zero-value protection on stop-loss and take-profit parameters, which could accidentally be set to 0 causing unlimited risk exposure
No spread filter mechanism, potentially executing trades at extreme slippage in illiquid markets

It uses a custom CoppockHist indicator with configurable ROC periods, smoothing, and applied price, and delegates trade execution and money management to the TradeAlgorithms library.
